questions.prompt: What should implement an ordinary icon-only Add action?
questions.explanation: The semantic component provides role, click action, focus, touch behaviour, and a spoken label.
options: A decorative Icon with null label

questions.prompt: Automated accessibility checks replace manual TalkBack testing.
questions.explanation: Automation finds classes of defects but cannot judge complete task usability and wording.

questions.prompt: What is the best first fix for clipped large text?
questions.explanation: The interface must honour user scaling and adjust its structure to available space.

questions.prompt: A root key handler should consume every keyboard event.
questions.explanation: Controls and text input require expected key behaviour; only owned shortcuts should be consumed.

questions.prompt: What should identify a category internally?
questions.explanation: Identity must remain unchanged across locale and presentation changes.

questions.prompt: Every image should be mirrored in RTL.
questions.explanation: Only direction-dependent content should mirror; many symbols and real-world images retain direction.

questions.prompt: What should nested content do after parent padding already handles an inset?
questions.explanation: Consumption communicates that descendants should only account for remaining safe area.

questions.prompt: Edge-to-edge means controls should always sit underneath system bars.
questions.explanation: Backgrounds can extend while critical and interactive content respects appropriate safe areas.
